workflow: model repair at 520x500 working resolution, then converge to 260x250 logical grid and 1040x1000 output

rounds.name: round-1
rounds.operation: model repaired broken lines, fills, icons and glyphs; bottom blank margin cropped

rounds.name: round-2
rounds.operation: model conservatively regularized border continuity, table cells and button bevels at 520x500 working resolution

rounds.name: final
rounds.operation: strict 260x250 grid convergence plus repaired glyph pixels from round 2

rounds.name: round-3
rounds.operation: merged the separate redstone torch and ignore dropdown controls into one continuous button, then reconverged through 520x500 working resolution

exceptions: Non-uniform blocks are intentionally concentrated in repaired text and numeric glyph pixels.
